notes.title: Surrogate Key Formula
notes.content:
('x' || left(md5(source_system::text || '|' || natural_key::text), 15))::bit(60)::bigint
Implemented as a macro casting every part to text. WTT player_id is hashed as 'ittf|'||id. Facts carry stable source_player_sk plus resolved player_sk.

notes.title: level_source Schema & Folder Pattern
notes.content: Both Postgres schemas and dbt folders use level_source: ingest_<src> -> staging_<src> (tables for JSONB, views for thin models) -> marts_<src> -> unified marts (views, UNION ALL). Run history is local (ingest_wtt.ingest_runs); the migration ledger is public.schema_version; dbt_default stays empty.

notes.title: fct_singles scope & result types
notes.content: fct_singles is strictly 1v1: sub_event_type like '%Singles' AND no second player on either side (NOT NULL alone also passes doubles). Team ties and LIVE matches are excluded. Walkovers/injury/retirement/DSQ are KEPT, flagged via result_type, is_default_result, defaulting_side and is_rating_eligible; their game scores are fabricated upstream so games/points are NULL. MLTT uses match_format='fixed_3_sets', scoring_rule='points_won'.

notes.title: Match cleaning rules
notes.content: See docs/database-design.md section 10. Only ~11% of entries have scores. 82% of singles are youth (age_category parsed from document_code). LIVE excluded. comp_x_scores unreliable: use results_game_scores. Competitor 1 wins ~62% (side order not random).
